chunks: And Muḥammad ibn Muslim asked Abū Jaʿfar عليه السلام.
About a man who slaughtered and said: subḥān Allāh, or allāhu akbar, or lā ilāha illā Allāh, or al-ḥamdu li-llāh, to Allah, Mighty and Majestic.
He said: "All of this is from the names of Allah, Exalted is He; there is no harm in it."

key_terms.فَسَبَّحَ: he glorified Allah by saying words of tasbih
key_terms.لَا بَأْسَ بِهِ: there is no harm in it; it is permissible
key_terms.هَلَّلَ: he proclaimed tawhid by saying lā ilāha illā Allāh

ai.seo_question: Is it permissible to slaughter an animal while saying phrases like subḥān Allāh, allāhu akbar, lā ilāha illā Allāh, or al-ḥamdu li-llāh?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning slaughtering an animal while mentioning Allah by phrases of glorification, magnification, tawhid, or praise. Imam Abū Jaʿfar عليه السلام states that these expressions are among the names of Allah تعالى, so using them at the time of slaughter is permissible.
